summary: The per-key photo zoom variable was named --z-<key>, the same namespace as the z-index tokens: on the dish sheet (<1024) the photo layer read --z-sheet, the z-index token 50, as its zoom, so every sheet header photo on /menu was drawn 50x and blurred.
fix: The zoom variables are --zm-<key> (CSS and the inline styles photoViewStyle writes); the manifest field stays 'zoom'. A test fails if any variable the photo layer reads or writes is declared as a token, and an e2e check keeps every photo, sheet included, at scale 1 when no zoom is set.
